license_required.quote: it shall constitute a felony for any person to practice medicine in this state without a license

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of medicine

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of medicine

type.quote: The board shall have the authority to... Operate, manage, superintend and control the licensure of physicians and physician assistants

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses
umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created in the division of occupational and professional licenses the Idaho allied health advisory board

degree_required.value: Graduation from an acceptable school of medicine
degree_required.quote: proof of graduation from a medical school acceptable to the board

accrediting_body.value: National medical school accrediting organization acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.quote: "Acceptable school of medicine" means any school of medicine or school of osteopathic medicine that meets the standards or requirements of a national medical school accrediting organization acceptable to the board

required.quote: successful completion of a postgraduate training program acceptable to the board

duration.value: Postgraduate training program acceptable to the board
duration.quote: successful completion of a postgraduate training program acceptable to the board

kind.quote: "Intern" or "resident" means any person who has completed a course of study at an acceptable school of medicine and who is enrolled in a postgraduate medical training program

exams.name: Written examination on fitness to practice medicine
exams.quote: Each applicant must pass an examination conducted by or acceptable to the board that shall thoroughly test the applicant's fitness to practice medicine

exams.name: USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Examination) Steps 1 and 2
exams.quote: An international physician must possess a passing score on the United States medical licensing examination (USMLE) 1 and 2

exams.name: USMLE Step 3
exams.quote: the international physician has passed the USMLE 3 or equivalent exam as approved by the board

interval_years.quote: such licenses shall be issued for a period of no more than five (5) years, the exact period to be fixed by the board

available.quote: Any person seeking to be licensed to practice medicine as a physician in this state who is licensed to practice medicine in another state must successfully complete the following requirements

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, unrevoked, unsuspended license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in a state, territory or district of the United States or Canada and demonstrate requisite qualifications. Applicant with any disciplinary action in any jurisdiction is not eligible for licensure by endorsement.
requirements.quote: proof that the applicant holds a valid, unrevoked, unsuspended license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in a state, territory or district of the United States or Canada and the applicant demonstrates that he possesses the requisite qualifications to provide the same standard of health care as provided by licensed physicians in this state. ... An applicant with any disciplinary action, including past, pending, or confidential, by any board of medicine, licensing authority, medical society, professional society, hospital, medical school, or institution staff in any state, territory, district, or country is not eligible for licensure by endorsement.

exists.quote: The board shall have the authority to... Operate, manage, superintend and control the licensure of physicians and physician assistants

regulatory_model.quote: it shall constitute a felony for any person to practice medicine in this state without a license

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue licenses to practice medicine and osteopathic medicine to persons who have qualified therefor in accordance with the provisions of this act

is_mandatory.quote: it shall constitute a felony for any person to practice medicine in this state without a license

title_protection.quote: it is unlawful for any person to assume or use the title or designation "medical doctor," "medical physician," "osteopathic doctor," "osteopathic physician," "physician assistant," "M.D.," "D.O.," or "P.A," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device to indicate to the public that such person is licensed to practice medicine pursuant to this chapter unless such person is so licensed

scope_protection.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: (a) The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony, pleading guilty to a felony, or the finding of guilt by a jury or court of commission of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony, pleading guilty to a felony, or the finding of guilt by a jury or court of commission of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using false, fraudulent or forged statements or documents, diplomas or credentials in connection with any licensing or other requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using false, fraudulent or forged statements or documents, diplomas or credentials in connection with any licensing or other requirements of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this or any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in any unethical or unprofessional manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in any unethical or unprofessional manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting any person to practice medicine who is not authorized to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting any person to practice medicine who is not authorized to practice medicine as provided in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or procuring an unlawful abortion or aiding or abetting the performing or procuring of an unlawful abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or procuring an unlawful abortion or aiding or abetting the performing or procuring of an unlawful abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing health care which fails to meet the standard of health care provided by other qualified physicians or physician assistants in the same community or similar communities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing health care which fails to meet the standard of health care provided by other qualified physicians or physician assistants in the same community or similar communities, taking into account his training, experience and the degree of expertise to which he holds himself out to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or gifts or agreeing to split or divide fees or gifts received for professional services with any person, institution or corporation in exchange for referral
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or gifts or agreeing to split or divide fees or gifts received for professional services with any person, institution or corporation in exchange for referral

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving of rebates, either directly or indirectly
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving or receiving or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving of rebates, either directly or indirectly

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to obtain or renew a license to practice medicine, or revocation, suspension, or other discipline of a license to practice medicine by any other state, territory, district of the United States or Canada
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to obtain or renew a license to practice medicine, or revocation, suspension, or other discipline of a license to practice medicine by any other state, territory, district of the United States or Canada, unless it can be shown that such action was not related to the competence of the person to practice medicine or to any conduct designated herein

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic or hallucinogenic drugs to addicted persons to maintain their addictions and level of usage without attempting to treat the primary condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic or hallucinogenic drugs to addicted persons to maintain their addictions and level of usage without attempting to treat the primary condition requiring the use of narcotics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic, hypnotic, hallucinogenic, stimulating or dangerous drugs for other than treatment of any disease, injury or medical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic, hypnotic, hallucinogenic, stimulating or dangerous drugs for other than treatment of any disease, injury or medical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to safeguard the confidentiality of medical records or other medical information pertaining to identifiable patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to safeguard the confidentiality of medical records or other medical information pertaining to identifiable patients, except as required or authorized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly promoting the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods to a patient that are unnecessary and not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly promoting the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods to a patient that are unnecessary and not medically indicated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and intentionally representing that a manifestly incurable disease or injury or other manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and intentionally representing that a manifestly incurable disease or injury or other manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to supervise the activities of interns, residents, nurse practitioners, certified nurse-midwives, clinical nurse specialists, or physician assistants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to supervise the activities of interns, residents, nurse practitioners, certified nurse-midwives, clinical nurse specialists, or physician assistants

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine when a license pursuant to this chapter is suspended, revoked or inactive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine when a license pursuant to this chapter is suspended, revoked or inactive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine in violation of a voluntary restriction or terms of probation pursuant to this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine in violation of a voluntary restriction or terms of probation pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to divulge to the board upon demand the means, method, device or instrumentality used in the treatment of a disease, injury, ailment, or infirmity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to divulge to the board upon demand the means, method, device or instrumentality used in the treatment of a disease, injury, ailment, or infirmity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act constituting a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act constituting a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any conduct which constitutes an abuse or exploitation of a patient arising out of the trust and confidence placed in the physician by the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct which constitutes an abuse or exploitation of a patient arising out of the trust and confidence placed in the physician by the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to driving under the influence of alcohol, drugs or other intoxicating substances or being convicted of or pleading guilty to other drug or alcohol related criminal charges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to driving under the influence of alcohol, drugs or other intoxicating substances or being convicted of or pleading guilty to other drug or alcohol related criminal charges

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a board order entered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with a board order entered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act, chapter 95, title 39, Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a pattern of unprofessional or disruptive behavior or interaction in a health care setting that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely impact the quality of care rendered to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a pattern of unprofessional or disruptive behavior or interaction in a health care setting that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely impact the quality of care rendered to a patient. Such behavior does not have to have caused actual patient harm to be considered unprofessional or disruptive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interfering with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts or by use of threats of harassment against any patient, member of a board or committee on professional discipline, board staff, hearing officer, or witness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interfering with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts or by use of threats of harassment against any patient, member of a board or committee on professional discipline, board staff, hearing officer, or witness in an attempt to influence the outcome of a disciplinary proceeding, investigation, or other legal action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to an unlicensed person when the licensee knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified, or to a licensed person when the delegated activities are outside the licensed person's scope of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to: (a) An unlicensed person when the licensee knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or license to carry them out; or (b) A person licensed by this state to engage in activities which may involve the practice of medicine when the delegating licensee knows or has reason to know that the delegated activities are outside the licensed person's scope of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report the charge or conviction of a felony to the board within thirty (30) days of the charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report the charge or conviction of a felony to the board within thirty (30) days of the charge

definition_quote.value: The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science; or Offering, undertaking, or holding oneself out as able to do any of the acts described
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: (a) The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science; or (b) Offering, undertaking, or holding oneself out as able to do any of the acts described in paragraph (a) of this subsection

license_status_types.quote: The board may renew on an inactive basis, the license of a physician or physician assistant who is not practicing medicine in this state. Upon application and qualification, the board may issue, without examination, a volunteer's license to a physician or physician assistant who is retired from the active practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International physicians must meet specific requirements including graduation from an international medical program, post-graduate medical training, practice in home country for at least 3 years or 500 hours clinical experience in the United States, practice within the last 5 years or waiver, and basic English fluency demonstrated by passing occupational English test for medicine or equivalent exam approved by the board
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: "International physician" means any individual who: (a) Was not a legal resident of the United States or Canada when they attended and matriculated from an international medical program; (b) Has been granted a medical doctorate or substantially similar degree by an international medical program of good standing; (c) Has completed a residency or post-graduate medical training; (d) Has practiced medicine as a physician in good standing with the regulatory institution in such individual's home country for at least three (3) years after the completion of post-graduate medical training or completed at least five hundred (500) hours of clinical experience under direct physician supervision in a clinical setting in the United States; (e) Has practiced medicine within the last five (5) years or has a waiver from the board; and (f) Possesses basic fluency in the English language as demonstrated by a passing score on the occupational English test for medicine or other equivalent exam approved by the board

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A provider with an established provider-patient relationship may issue prescription drug orders via virtual care within the scope of the provider's license and according to applicable state and federal laws, rules, and regulations, including the Idaho community standard of care. However, the prescription drug shall not be a controlled substance unless prescribed in compliance with 21 U.S.C.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A provider with an established provider-patient relationship, including a relationship established pursuant to section 54-5705, Idaho Code, may issue prescription drug orders and prescription medical device orders via virtual care within the scope of the provider's license and according to any applicable state and federal laws, rules, and regulations, including the Idaho community standard of care. However, the prescription drug shall not be a controlled substance unless prescribed in compliance with 21 U.S.C.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The interstate medical licensure compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant shall collaborate with, consult with, or refer to the appropriate member of the facility health care team as indicated by: the condition of the patient; the education, experience, and competence of the physician assistant; and the community standard of care. The degree and nature of collaboration shall be determined by the facility or practice in which the physician assistant works and shall be set forth in facility bylaws or procedures for facilities that have credentialing and privileging systems or in a written collaborative practice agreement for all other facilities and practices

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants have prescriptive authority as determined by the board, subject to the scope of their license and applicable state and federal laws
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant may practice at a licensed health care facility, a facility with a credentialing and privileging system, a physician-owned facility or practice, or another facility or practice allowed by this chapter

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may refer all violations of this section made known to it to appropriate prosecuting attorneys. The board may render assistance to a prosecuting attorney in the prosecution of a case pursuant to this section.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Every physician and physician assistant who accepts the privilege of being licensed under this chapter gives consent to: (a) Submitting at the licensee's own expense to an immediate mental or physical examination when directed in writing by the board to do so

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may by rule provide for the issuance of a temporary license to a person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in some other state, territory, or district of the United States or Canada or to a person who is a diplomate of the national board of medical examiners or a diplomate of the national board of osteopathic medical examiners or to a physician assistant, excluding any volunteer license applicant, provided that such temporary license shall be issued only to persons who have made an application for a permanent license in this state
